name: Polukranos
description: A massive fifty-headed celestial hydra bound by the gods, who in the story awakens and is slain by the Champion of the Sun.

timeline.summary: Lanathos tells the leonin the tale of Polukranos and the Champion of the Sun, who slays the hydra at the Plateau of the Four Winds.
timeline.quote: Polukranos, eater of poleis, beloved of the gods, was no more.

relations.note: In the story the Champion kills Polukranos.
relations.quote: All that remained on the silent plateau was the Champion of Heliod, her spear shining in the sunlight.
